title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Style of Litigation Documents for Civil Retrial Application Cases
keywords_en: application for retrial; civil retrial application case
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Circular on Issuing the

Model Litigation Documents for

Civil Application for Retrial Cases

Fa [2011] No. 160

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In January 2011, the Supreme People's Court held the First National Conference on Civil Retrial Review Work in Guangzhou, where all high people's courts submitted constructive comments and suggestions on amending and improving the model litigation documents for civil application for retrial cases. In order to better guide people's courts at all levels in correctly applying the Civil Procedure Law and relevant judicial interpretations, and to further standardize and unify the drafting of litigation documents for civil application for retrial cases, we have formulated the Model Litigation Documents for Civil Application for Retrial Cases based on the actual circumstances of civil retrial review work, which are hereby issued to you. If any problems arise during the application of these model documents, please promptly report them to the Supreme People's Court.

This is hereby notified.

Attachments: 1. Basic Requirements for Drafting Litigation Documents for Civil Application for Retrial Cases

2. Model Litigation Documents for Civil Application for Retrial Cases

April 21, 2011

Attachment 1

Basic Requirements for Drafting Litigation Documents for Civil Application for Retrial Cases

I. Regarding the Basic Information of the Parties

(1) Where a party or a third party not involved in the case applies for retrial, such party shall be listed as "Applicant for Retrial"; where all parties apply for retrial, each shall be listed as "Applicant for Retrial"; the respondent named in the application for retrial shall be listed as "Respondent"; other original-trial parties who have neither applied for retrial nor been listed as respondents shall be listed sequentially according to their status in the first instance, second instance, and retrial, for example, "Plaintiff of First Instance, Respondent of Second Instance"; for cases applying for retrial against a ruling of non-acceptance, only the applicant for retrial shall be listed.

(2) In parentheses after "Applicant for Retrial" and "Respondent", the litigation status of the parties in the first instance, second instance, and retrial shall be listed in the format "Plaintiff of First Instance, Counterclaim Defendant (or Defendant of First Instance, Counterclaim Plaintiff), Appellant of Second Instance (or Respondent of Second Instance), Original Applicant for Retrial (or Original Respondent)"; where a civil application for retrial case has undergone two or more retrials, the retrial litigation status in parentheses shall be listed according to the party's status in the last retrial; where the retrial procedure is initiated by a protest of the People's Procuratorate or ex officio by the people's court, the retrial litigation status in parentheses shall be listed as "Original Complainant (or Original Respondent)"; where a third party not involved in the case applies for retrial, it shall be listed in parentheses as "Third Party Not Involved in the Case".

(3) Where there is a change in the name of a party, the original name shall be indicated in parentheses after the current name.

(4) Where the party is a natural person, the name, gender, ethnicity, date of birth, occupation, and address shall be listed; if the occupation of the natural person is not clear, it may be omitted; where the party is a legal person or other organization, the name, domicile, and the name and position of the legal representative or principal responsible person shall be listed.

(5) Where the party is a natural person, the address shall be written as "Residing at (specific address)"; if the address stated in the application for retrial is inconsistent with the address stated in the effective judgment or identity card, the address shall be written as "Residing at (address stated in identity card), currently residing at (address stated in the application for retrial)". Where the party is a legal person or other organization, the domicile shall be written as "Domicile: (domicile stated in the business license)".

Where the party's address or domicile is within a municipal district, it shall be written as "XX Province (Directly Administered Municipality, Autonomous Region) XX City XX District (specific address)"; where the party's address or domicile is within a municipal county or a county-level city under municipal administration, it shall be written as "XX Province (Directly Administered Municipality, Autonomous Region) XX County (City) (specific address)", without stating the prefecture-level city (prefecture); if two or more parties share the same address, each shall be stated separately, and the phrase "same address as above" shall not be used as a substitute.

(6) The legal representative or principal responsible person of a legal person or other organization shall be written as "Legal Representative (or Responsible Person): XXX, Chairman of the Board (or Factory Director, Director, or other position) of the Company (or Factory, Village Committee, etc.)".

(7) Where the agent ad litem is a lawyer, it shall be written as "Agent ad litem: XXX, Lawyer of XX Law Firm", and the lawyer's practice license, letter from the law firm, power of attorney, and scope of authority shall be verified; where the agents ad litem are lawyers from the same law firm, the respective law firms shall be stated separately; where an intern lawyer from the same law firm and a lawyer jointly serve as agents ad litem, the intern lawyer shall be written as "Agent ad litem: XXX, Intern Lawyer of XX Law Firm"; where the agent ad litem is a legal worker, it shall be written as "Agent ad litem: XXX, Legal Worker of XX Legal Service Office".

Where the agent ad litem is a natural person, it shall be written as "Agent ad litem: XXX, gender, ethnicity, date of birth, occupation, address", and the agent's identity card, power of attorney, and scope of authority shall be verified; where the agent ad litem is a close relative of the party, the relationship with the party shall also be indicated in parentheses after the name; where a lawyer's assistant participates in the litigation as an agent ad litem, the basic information such as name and gender shall be stated in the manner applicable to a natural person agent ad litem; where an employee of a legal person or other organization, authorized by the entity, acts in litigation on its behalf, it shall be written as "Agent ad litem: XXX, Employee (position may be stated) of the Company (or Factory, Village Committee, etc.)", and the employee's identity card, power of attorney, and scope of authority shall be verified.

(8) The litigation status and the name of the party or agent shall be separated by a colon.

Example:

Applicant for Retrial (Defendant of First Instance, Respondent of Second Instance, Original Respondent): XX Biotechnology Engineering Co., Ltd. (formerly XX Biotechnology Research Institute). Domicile: No. XX, XX Street, XX District, XX City, XX Province.

Legal Representative: XXX, Chairman of the Board of the Company.

Agent ad litem: XXX, Legal Counsel of the Company.

Agent ad litem: XXX, Lawyer of XX Law Firm.

Respondent (Plaintiff of First Instance, Appellant of Second Instance, Original Applicant for Retrial): XX Bank XX Branch. Domicile: No. XX, XX Road, XX District, Beijing.

Responsible Person: XXX, General Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: XXX, Lawyer of XX Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: XXX, Intern Lawyer of XX Law Firm.

Defendant of First Instance, Appellant of Second Instance: XX City Municipal Administration Bureau. Domicile: No. XX, XX Road, XX City, XX Province.

Legal Representative: XXX, Director of the Bureau.

II. Regarding the Source of the Case Section

(1) In this section, an abbreviation shall be indicated in parentheses after the full name of the party.

(2) The abbreviations of the parties shall be consistent, concise, and standardized, reflecting the characteristics of the parties.

(3) Other original-trial parties who have neither applied for retrial nor been listed as respondents shall be listed after the respondent, sequentially according to their litigation status in the first instance, second instance, and retrial. Where a civil application for retrial case has undergone two or more retrials, the retrial litigation status shall be listed according to the party's status in the last retrial; where the retrial procedure is initiated by a protest of the People's Procuratorate or ex officio by the people's court, the retrial litigation status shall be listed as "Original Complainant (or Original Respondent)".

(4) The judgment document subject to the application for retrial shall be stated as "dissatisfied with the civil judgment (ruling, mediation document) (XXXX) X Fa Min X Zi No. XX of XX People's Court".

Example:

The applicant for retrial, Tiancheng Biotechnology Engineering Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tiancheng Company), in the dispute over an intermediation contract with the respondent, Zhongyang Technology Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Zhongyang Company), and the defendant of first instance and appellant of second instance, XX City Municipal Administration Bureau (hereinafter referred to as XX City Administration Bureau), being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (XXXX) X Fa Min XX Zi No. XX of XX Province XX People's Court, applied to this court for retrial. This court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to review this case, and the review is now concluded.

III. Regarding the Facts and Grounds for the Application for Retrial Section

(1) The first sentence of this section shall state "XXX (abbreviation of the applicant for retrial) applies for retrial on the grounds that:", followed by the specific facts and grounds, separated by a colon.

(2) The facts and grounds for the application for retrial shall be summarized generally, making them concise, accurate, and comprehensive, avoiding verbatim copying of the specific facts and grounds listed in the application for retrial.

(3) Where there are multiple facts and grounds for the application for retrial, divided into multiple levels, the structural level ordinal numbers shall be written in the order "(1)", "1", and "(a)", noting that no pause mark is used after "(1)" and "(a)", and a period is placed at the lower right of Arabic numerals in structural level ordinal numbers, not a comma or pause mark; where there is only one level, the structural level ordinal numbers shall be written as "1", "2", "3"; where there are two levels, they shall be written as "(1)" and "1"; where there are three levels, they shall be written as "(1)", "1", and "(a)".

(4) This section shall conclude with the legal basis for the application for retrial, stated as "XXX applies for retrial pursuant to Article XX, paragraph X, subparagraph X of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China."

Example:

XX Company applies for retrial on the grounds that: (1) The first and second instance judgments in this case suffer from the issue of improper defendant subject qualification. (Grounds summarized). (2) This case violates legal provisions and involves jurisdictional error. 1. This case is not subject to exclusive jurisdiction. 2. This case involves a contract dispute. 3. The parties agreed on jurisdiction. (3) The judgment in this case lacks factual basis. XX Company applies for retrial pursuant to subparagraphs (2), (6), and (7) of paragraph 1 of Article 179 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

IV. Regarding the Section on the Respondent's Opinion

(1) Where the respondent submits an opinion in writing or orally, it shall be stated as "XXX submitted an opinion stating that XXX's application for retrial lacks factual and legal basis and requests that it be dismissed"; the opinion of the respondent may also be summarized based on the circumstances of the case.

(2) Where the respondent has not submitted a written or oral opinion, no statement shall be made.

V. Regarding the Section on Facts Found by This Court in Review

For cases where the application for retrial is dismissed, if new facts related to the grounds for the application for retrial were discovered during the review process, such facts may be stated in this section, without commenting on the facts found in the original trial. Changes to the litigation subject qualifications of the parties shall be stated in this section.

VI. Regarding the Section on "This Court Holds After Review"

This section shall analyze and evaluate each ground and reason for the application for retrial individually, avoiding omissions.

VII. Several Technical Requirements

(1) To avoid ambiguity, the term "original trial" shall not be used in rulings; the specific trial level shall be indicated, such as "second instance court" or "retrial judgment".

(2) When referring to this court in the ruling, "this court" shall be used, and "our court" shall not be used.

(3) Where a party has an abbreviation, the full name of the party shall be used in the sections on basic information of the parties, source of the case, and the main body of the ruling; in the remaining parts of the ruling, the abbreviation shall be used to refer to that party, and substitutes such as "applicant for retrial" or "respondent" shall not be used. Parties appearing infrequently need not use abbreviations.

(4) On the first citation of a law or judicial interpretation, the full name shall be written and the abbreviation indicated, such as "The Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Contract Law)", and thereafter the abbreviation shall be used without title marks. Laws or judicial interpretations cited infrequently need not use abbreviations.

(5) When citing provisions of laws and regulations, the article number shall be stated in Chinese characters, such as "Article 66 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China". When citing judicial interpretations, if the article number in the judicial interpretation uses Chinese characters, the article number shall be stated in Chinese characters, such as "Article 10 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation (II) on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China"; if the article number in the judicial interpretation uses Arabic numerals, the article number shall be stated in Arabic numerals, such as "Article 1 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China".

(6) For Arabic numerals of five digits or more, the digits shall be written consecutively, without spaces or thousands separators, such as "123456 yuan"; if there are many trailing zeros, the number may be converted into units of ten thousand or one hundred million, such as "100,000 yuan". A multi-digit number written in Arabic numerals shall not be split across lines.

These provisions shall take effect from the date of issuance.

Attachment 2

Model Litigation Documents for Civil Application for Retrial Cases

Table of Contents

1. Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case (for notifying the applicant for retrial)

2. Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case (for notifying the respondent)

3. Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case (for notifying other original-trial parties)

4. Confirmation of Service Address for Parties

5. Letter Requesting Transfer of Case Files

6. Review Report

Model 1: Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case (for notifying the applicant for retrial)

XXX People's Court

Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case

(XXXX) X Min Shen (Min Zai Shen) Zi No. XX

XXX (state the name of the applicant for retrial):

You (your entity), in the dispute with XXX (state the name of the opposing party), XXX (state the names of other original-trial parties) concerning (cause of action), being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (ruling or mediation document) (XXXX) X Min XX No. XX rendered by XXX People's Court on XX, XX, XX, have applied to this court for retrial, and this court has docketed the case for review.

This is hereby notified.

Note: If you need to submit or supplement materials to this court, a list of materials shall be provided and sent together by post to: XXX (state the case undertaker), XX Division, XX People's Court, No. XX, XX Road, XX City, XX Province; Postal Code: XXX.

XX, XX, XX

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

1. This notice shall be used by the higher people's court when notifying the party applying for retrial after accepting the application for retrial.

2. The name of the court in the title shall be consistent with the text on the court seal, but basic people's courts shall include the name of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government.

3. Pursuant to Articles 178, 179, and 184 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Articles 1 and 7 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Trial Supervision Procedure of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, where a party applies for retrial to the higher people's court of the original trial court within the statutory period for applying for retrial, based on the retrial grounds listed in the Civil Procedure Law, and the submitted application for retrial and other materials meet the prescribed conditions, the higher people's court shall accept the case in accordance with the law and complete the registration and acceptance procedures, including sending the notice of acceptance to the applicant for retrial, within five days. In the notice of acceptance, the party shall be informed that its application for retrial has been docketed for review.

Model 2: Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case (for notifying the respondent)

XXX People's Court

Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case

(XXXX) X Min Shen (Min Zai Shen) Zi No. XX

XXX (state the name of the respondent):

XXX (state the name of the applicant for retrial), in the dispute with you (your entity), XXX (state the names of other original-trial parties) concerning (cause of action), being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (ruling or mediation document) (XXXX) X Min XX No. XX rendered by XXX People's Court on XX, XX, XX, has applied to this court for retrial, and this court has docketed the case for review. We hereby serve you (your entity) with a copy of the application for retrial. You (your entity) shall submit a written opinion within fifteen days from receipt of the copy of the application for retrial; failure to submit a written opinion shall not affect the review by this court.

This is hereby notified.

Note: If you need to submit or supplement materials to this court, a list of materials shall be provided and sent together by post to: XXX (state the case undertaker), XX Division, XX People's Court, No. XX, XX Road, XX City, XX Province; Postal Code: XXX.

Attachments: 1. One copy of the application for retrial

2. One confirmation of service address for parties

XX, XX, XX

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

1. This notice shall be used by the higher people's court when notifying the respondent after accepting the application for retrial.

2. Pursuant to Article 180 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 7 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Trial Supervision Procedure of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, after accepting an application for retrial, the higher people's court shall, within five days, send a notice of acceptance of the case and a copy of the application for retrial to the opposing party. The opposing party includes the respondent and other original-trial parties.

3. To facilitate the smooth progress of the retrial review work, when sending the notice of acceptance and the copy of the application for retrial to the respondent, the confirmation of service address for parties shall be attached.

Model 3: Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case (for notifying other original-trial parties)

XXX People's Court

Notice of Acceptance of Civil Application for Retrial Case

(XXXX) X Min Shen (Min Zai Shen) Zi No. XX

XXX (state the name of other original-trial parties):

XXX (state the name of the applicant for retrial), in the dispute with XXX (state the name of the respondent) and you (your entity) concerning (cause of action), being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (ruling or mediation document) (XXXX) X Min XX No. XX rendered by XXX People's Court on XX, XX, XX, has applied to this court for retrial, and this court has docketed the case for review. We hereby serve you (your entity) with a copy of the application for retrial. You (your entity) shall submit a written opinion within fifteen days from receipt of the copy of the application for retrial; failure to submit a written opinion shall not affect the review by this court.

This is hereby notified.

Note: If you need to submit or supplement materials to this court, a list of materials shall be provided and sent together by post to: XXX (state the case undertaker), XX Division, XX People's Court, No. XX, XX Road, XX City, XX Province; Postal Code: XXX.

Attachments: 1. One copy of the application for retrial

2. One confirmation of service address for parties

XX, XX, XX

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

1. This notice shall be used by the higher people's court when notifying other original-trial parties after accepting the application for retrial.

2. In accordance with Article 180 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and Article 7 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC in the Trial Supervision Procedure, after accepting a retrial application, the court of the next higher level shall, within five days, serve a notice of case acceptance and a copy of the retrial application on the opposing party. The opposing party includes the respondent and other parties in the original trial.

3. To facilitate the smooth progress of the retrial review, when serving the notice of acceptance and the copy of the retrial application on other parties in the original trial, a confirmation of service address for the parties shall be attached.

Form 4:

XXX People's Court

Confirmation of Service Address for Parties

After receipt, please fill it out and return it within one week.

Back page of Confirmation of Service Address for Parties

Supreme People's Court

Certain Provisions on Serving Civil Litigation Documents by Court Express Mail

(Excerpt)

Article 1 Scope of Application of Court Express

Where the people's court has difficulty in directly serving litigation documents, it may entrust delivery by court express mail through the national postal authority (hereinafter referred to as the "postal authority"), except in any of the following circumstances:

(1) The person to be served, or his agent ad litem, or the person designated by the person to be served to receive service, agrees to appear at the people's court to accept service within a specified period;

(2) The whereabouts of the person to be served are unknown;

(3) There is a special method of service provided by law or stipulated in an international treaty concluded or acceded to by the PRC.

Article 2 Legal Effect of Court Express

Where civil litigation documents are served by court express mail, the service shall have the same legal effect as service by the people's court.

Article 3 Provision or Confirmation of Service Address

When filing a lawsuit or answering a complaint, a party shall provide or confirm its accurate service address to the people's court and fill out a confirmation of service address form. If the party refuses to provide such an address, the people's court shall inform it of the adverse consequences of refusal and record this in the court record.

Article 5 Presumption of Service Address

Where a party refuses to provide its service address and still does not provide it after being informed by the people's court, for a natural person, the domicile recorded in the household registration or the habitual residence shall be the service address; for a legal person or other organization, the domicile recorded in its business registration or other legally registered or filed information shall be the service address.

Article 11 Legal Consequences and Exceptions

If the litigation documents are not actually received by the person to be served due to inaccuracy of the service address provided or confirmed by the person to be served, refusal to provide a service address, failure to timely inform the people's court of a change in service address, or refusal by the person to be served or the person designated by the person to be served to receive the documents, the date on which the documents are returned shall be deemed the date of service.

If the person to be served can prove that it was not at fault during the process of service of the litigation documents, the preceding paragraph shall not apply.

Form 6: Review Report

Review Report on the Case of Dispute over (Cause of Action) Between Applicant for Retrial XXX and Respondent XXX

(XXXX) Min Shen (Min Zai Shen) Zi No. XX

I. Source of the Case

The applicant for retrial, XXX (state the name of the applicant), in the case of dispute over (cause of action) with the respondent XXX (state the name of the respondent), XXX (state the names of other parties in the original trial), etc., being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (ruling or mediation statement) (XXXX) Min XX Zi No. XX of the XXX People's Court, has applied to this court for a retrial.

Briefly summarize the litigation process, expressed as: "This case was originally filed by XXX (state the name of the plaintiff) on ____ year ____ month ____ day with the XXX People's Court, which issued the civil judgment (ruling or mediation statement) (XXXX) Min XX Zi No. XX on ____ year ____ month ____ day. XXX, being dissatisfied, appealed to the XXX People's Court, which issued the civil judgment (XXXX) Min XX Zi No. XX on ____ year ____ month ____ day."

II. Basic Information of the Parties

Applicant for retrial (status in first instance and second instance): XXX Company. Domicile: No. XX, __ Street, __ District, __ City, __ Province.

Legal representative: XXX, position.

Agent ad litem: XXX, lawyer at XXX Law Firm.

Respondent (status in first instance and second instance): XXX, male/female, ethnicity, date of birth, occupation, residing at No. XX, __ Road, __ County, __ Province.

Agent ad litem: XXX, male/female, ethnicity, date of birth, occupation, residing at No. XX, __ Road, __ County, __ Province.

III. Circumstances of the First Instance

Summarize the facts found and the adjudication of the first instance, and state the plaintiff's claims. From this section onwards, after the first use of the full name of a party, an abbreviation shall be noted, and consistency of abbreviations shall be maintained.

IV. Circumstances of the Second Instance

Summarize the appellant's grounds and claims on appeal, and the facts found and the adjudication of the second instance in the second instance.

If the facts found in the second instance are the same as those in the first instance, do not repeat them.

V. Grounds for Retrial and Opinions of the Respondent

Summarize the retrial grounds asserted by the applicant and the specific factual reasons, making them concise, accurate, and comprehensive.

Summarize the written or oral opinions of the respondent for reference by the collegiate panel during its deliberation.

If other parties in the original trial have expressed written or oral opinions, those shall also be summarized.

VI. Facts Found During the Review

If new facts related to the grounds for retrial were found during the review process, or if there were changes in the litigation status of the parties, set them forth in this section.

VII. Review Opinion of the Case Handler

Analyze and evaluate each ground and reason for retrial one by one, and propose a clear handling opinion, avoiding omissions.

VIII. Issues Requiring Explanation

If there are other special circumstances such as increased conflict or significant social impact, these may be explained in this section.

IX. Opinion of the Collegiate Panel

For cases requiring discussion by the presiding judge joint meeting, state the opinion of the collegiate panel.

Case handler: (signature)

____ year ____ month ____ day

Form 7: Civil Ruling (For Retrial by This Court)

XXX People's Court

Civil Ruling

(XXXX) Min Shen (Min Zai Shen) Zi No. XX

Applicant for retrial (status in first instance and second instance): ... (state the name or title and basic information).

Legal representative (or responsible person): ... (state name and position).

Statutory agent (or designated agent): ... (state name and basic information).

Agent ad litem: ... (state name and basic information).

Respondent (status in first instance and second instance): ... (state the name or title and basic information).

Legal representative (or responsible person): ... (state name and position).

Statutory agent (or designated agent): ... (state name and basic information).

Agent ad litem: ... (state name and basic information).

Plaintiff in the first instance (or other designation in the effective judgment): ... (state the name or title and basic information).

Legal representative (or responsible person): ... (state name and position).

Statutory agent (or designated agent): ... (state name and basic information).

Agent ad litem: ... (state name and basic information).

The applicant for retrial, XXX, in the case of dispute over (cause of action) with the respondent XXX, XXX (state the names of other parties in the original trial), etc., being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (ruling or mediation statement) (XXXX) Min XX Zi No. XX of the XXX People's Court, applied to this court for a retrial. This court formed a collegiate panel in accordance with the law to review this case, and the review has now been concluded.

This court holds that XXX's application for retrial meets the circumstances stipulated in Article 179, paragraph 1, item ... (or paragraph 2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC. Pursuant to Article 181 and Article 185 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC (if the application for retrial is against a mediation statement, it shall be expressed as "XXX's application for retrial meets the circumstances stipulated in Article 182 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC. Pursuant to Article 182 and Article 185 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC"), it is ruled as follows:

1. The case shall be retried by this court;
2. During the retrial, the execution of the original judgment (ruling or mediation statement) shall be suspended.

President XXX

____ year ____ month ____ day

(Court seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk XXX

Notes:

1. This form of civil ruling is to be used when the court of the next higher level, after reviewing a retrial application filed by a party, determines that the case meets the circumstances stipulated in Article 179 or Article 182 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and rules to retry the case by itself.
2. The status of the parties shall be expressed as "Applicant for retrial (status in first instance and second instance)" and "Respondent (status in first instance and second instance)". Other parties shall be expressed according to their status in the original trial, for example, in a case where the judgment of first instance is final, they shall be listed as "Plaintiff in the first instance" or "Defendant in the first instance", "Third party in the first instance"; in a case where there is a second instance, they shall be listed as "Plaintiff in first instance, appellant in second instance" or "Defendant in first instance, respondent in second instance", etc.
3. When setting forth the reasons for the ruling, it is sufficient to point out that the case meets the circumstances stipulated in Article ___, paragraph __, item __ of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC; specific reasons need not be stated. Expressions such as "the original judgment is indeed erroneous" or "the original judgment's facts are unclear or the application of the law is erroneous" shall not be used. If the parties reach a mediation agreement during the retrial review stage and apply for a civil mediation statement to be issued after the court rules to retry the case by itself, the reason for the retrial ruling shall be expressed as "This case meets the requirements of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC".
4. If both parties apply for retrial, and the grounds asserted by one party are established while those asserted by the other party are not, this ruling shall only state that one party's application for retrial meets the circumstances stipulated in Article ___, paragraph __, item __ of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, and need not express an opinion on whether the other party's application for retrial is established.
5. Pursuant to Article 185 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, this ruling shall be signed by the president of the people's court.

Form 8: Civil Ruling (For Directing the Lower Court to Retry)

XXX People's Court

Civil Ruling

(XXXX) Min Shen (Min Zai Shen) Zi No. XX
